in_sanskrit.name: Sanil
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है God of the moon
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Sanil एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Sanil is a Sanskrit and Hindi name derived from the word 'Sanam' which means 'Moon'. The name 'Sanil' is believed to be a divine name for a boy, signifying the presence of the moon god in his life.
